messages:
elena: Quick heads-up — we're doing a stepped sunset for the v1 API (not full immediate shutdown). Targeting April 15 for the first gateway redirects. Need a concise migration guide + localized banner text for EU/APAC docs pages. Also found an auth header phrasing that causes our Go SDK to reject tokens.

samir: thanks — good call. can we split into: 1) user-facing banner copy per locale, 2) redirect map, 3) SDK auth note + code example?

anya: I can take localization strings for en-US, fr-FR, and ja-JP. will draft short banners (1 line + learn more link). any legal/reg required phrasing?

elena: no new legal text, but include: "Planned deprecation: v1 API. Migrate to v2 by YYYY-MM-DD" and a link to the migration guide. keep under 140 chars.

michael: digging into the SDK auth issue — Go SDK trims header values differently. repro: tokens with leading "Bearer " vs exact matching. we'll add a compatibility note + snippet.

michael: snippet for docs (suggested):
```
// recommended auth header handling (Go)
req.Header.Set("Authorization", strings.TrimSpace("Bearer "+token))
resp, _ := client.Do(req)
```

elena: perfect. also need redirect rules for web docs router. propose short mapping so old links keep working while we show banners.

samir: proposed redirect snippet for nginx/router:
```
# legacy v1 doc routes -> v2 compat pages
location ~ ^/docs/v1/(.*)$ {
  return 301 /docs/v2/compat/$1;
}
```

anya: I'll localize the banner and put a small CTA: "Read migration steps" linking to /docs/v2/migrate-v1. will PR translations into repo.

docs-bot: PR opened by @anya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 — banners + translations (en/fr/ja).

elena: thanks @anya — can @michael add the SDK auth blurb to /docs/v2/migrate-v1#auth? keep it under the SDK section.

michael: on it. will add Go example + a short note about whitespace/token prefixes. also will add a test in the Go SDK repo to avoid regressions.

samir: who will own the redirect rollout and smoke test? need a short checklist in the PR: 1) redirect rule deployed to staging, 2) banner appears for staging locales, 3) smoke check old links.

elena: I'll own smoke tests and final rollout. @docs-bot can you queue an ops task when PRs land? :clipboard:

docs-bot: Created task #OPS-3380: staged-redirect-smoke-test. Assigned to elena.

anya: timeline: I can get translations + PR updates by EOD Friday.

michael: I'll have Go SDK note + test PR by Monday.

elena: great. once both PRs are merged, I'll schedule the staged redirect for the 15th (low-traffic window). update this thread when PRs are merged. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PRs merged: #4521, #4523. Redirect task scheduled for 2026-04-15 02:00 UTC.
